name: ClipFlow Pro
description:
Clipboard history manager for GNOME Shell 45–51.

This extension reads and stores your clipboard (copied text) locally to build a searchable history. Nothing is sent anywhere; history stays on your computer and can be paused, excluded per app or cleared.

* History window and panel menu with search
* Pin and star entries
* Paste or insert past entries
* Privacy controls: ignore passwords, pause on lock, clear on logout

No keyboard shortcuts are set by default; you can add them in Settings → Shortcuts.
